option_relations.rationale: Atypical Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (aHUS) is a specific form of Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS). The option describes a specific type of HUS with a precipitating factor.

Pancreatitis-Associated Thrombotic Microangiopathy is a specific clinical presentation that can encompass or be a form of Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS), as HUS is a type of thrombotic microangiopathy.
The option 'Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS)' is identical to the provided leaf 'Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS)'.
